changelog: HUGE Optimization — Major performance improvements across the Launcher, reducing CPU usage, memory overhead and loading times.
GPU Acceleration — Improved GPU utilization for smoother rendering and reduced CPU workload.
Telegram Post Optimizations — Improved rendering performance.
QWebEngineView Lifecycle Management — Improved browser instance creation, reuse and cleanup to prevent unnecessary background processes and CPU usage.
Autoscroll Mode — Added automatic scrolling for Home section images, with smoother transitions and improved manual navigation.
Maps Section — Double-click to switch between map tabs.
Standalone BAT Playtime Tracking — Added playtime tracking when launching Quake 3 directly through the Vulkan Cinematic shortcut, without starting the Launcher.
Startup Behavior Fixes — Fixed an issue where Start with Windows and Start minimized could send the Launcher to the system tray even when Minimize to tray was disabled.
General UI & Stability Improvements — Various fixes and refinements to navigation, rendering and Launcher behavior.
